title: Resolution declaring Clubhouse Awareness Week in New York City
summary: This resolution would declare the first full week of May as Clubhouse Awareness Week in New York City to recognize Clubhouses, community programs supporting people with serious mental illness. It notes that New York City currently has 13 Clubhouses serving over 3,600 members as of fiscal year 2025, a number projected to nearly double by 2027. The designation aligns with Clubhouse International's U.S. Clubhouse Week of Action.
